title: Privacy Notice
lead: How YFP Assurance handles the information you share through this website.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.text: When you submit an inquiry, we receive the details you enter, such as your name, company, country, email address, phone number and the content of your message.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.text: We use this information only to respond to your inquiry, prepare quotations and deliver the services you request. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Service providers
sections.text: Inquiries may be delivered through a third-party form or email service, and may be shared with sourcing partners only where needed to prepare your quotation or fulfil your order.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.text: You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information you have provided by contacting us through the contact page.
